Description

This 2022 Ram 1500 Big Horn/Lone Star in striking red combines capability with thoughtful comfort features designed for truck owners who value both performance and daily functionality.

- Back Up Camera
- Clean Carfax
- One Owner
- Alloy Wheels
- Bluetooth
- Navigation/GPS
- EcoDiesel 3.0L V6 Turbocharged Engine
- 4WD with Anti-Spin Differential Rear Axle
- Uconnect 5 Nav with 12.0" Touchscreen Display
- Google Android Auto and Apple CarPlay
- SiriusXM Satellite Radio with 4G LTE Wi-Fi Hot Spot
- Heated Front Seats and Heated Steering Wheel
- Power 8-Way Driver Seat with 2-Way Lumbar Adjust
- Trailer Brake Control
- Class IV Receiver Hitch

Under the hood sits a capable EcoDiesel 3.0L V6 Turbocharged engine paired with an 8-Speed Automatic transmission and 4WD, delivering 21 city and 29 highway MPG for a truck that works efficiently. The Night Edition package adds distinctive visual elements including black headlamp bezels, black exterior truck badging, and dual exhaust with black tips, along with 20-inch premium paint and polished wheels that give this truck a refined appearance.

The truck's cabin reflects Ram's commitment to driver comfort and convenience. The Uconnect 5 navigation system with its expansive 12.0-inch touchscreen provides intuitive control, while Google Android Auto and Apple CarPlay integration keep you connected on every drive. Heated front seats, a heated steering wheel, and dual-zone automatic climate control ensure comfort through changing seasons. The power 8-way driver seat with lumbar adjustment allows you to find your ideal driving position.

Practical features define this Big Horn/Lone Star throughout. The rear power sliding window, rear underseat compartment storage, and in-floor storage bins maximize organizational options. SiriusXM satellite radio with 360L service, 9 amplified speakers with a subwoofer, and a media hub with USB charging keep entertainment and connectivity within reach. The ParkSense front and rear park assist system with stop capability aids maneuverability in tight spaces.

This truck is equipped with the Big Horn Level B Equipment Group, which includes a comprehensive set of technology and comfort features. The Cold Weather Group with an engine block heater and MOPAR winter front grille cover prepares this truck for demanding conditions. The Class IV receiver hitch and trailer brake control make towing straightforward and controlled.

Built on a one-owner history backed by a clean Carfax report, this Ram 1500 Big Horn/Lone Star represents a truck ready to serve you faithfully for years to come. Visit our showroom to experience the capability and refinement this truck delivers.
